entities.summary:
Étienne-Paul-Victor Monceaux was a 19th-20th-century French historian. A professor at the 
Collège de France from 1907 to 1937, he was elected a member of the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres in 1912. His major speciality was Christian Latinity in the Roman provinces of North Africa.
